title: dot-agents project manifest
description: Repo-local schema for .agentsrc.json. Accepts both v1 and v2 of the manifest surface. v1 omits the v2 additive fields (repo_id, extends, packages, features, and the Source.id/cache_ttl/auth + http/oci source types). All v2 fields are optional so a v1 file continues to validate against this schema.

version.description: Schema version. 1 = legacy surface; 2 = surface that activates the v2 additive fields.

gitignore_projections.description: Whether `da install` / `da refresh` maintain the dot-agents-managed block in this repo's .gitignore covering the outputs they project (platform links, generated configs, *.dot-agents-backup). Absent means enabled; set false to skip the block and remove one a previous run wrote. Only untracked files are affected — a projection the repo already commits stays tracked.

graph_home.description: Path to KG_HOME. Overrides KG_HOME env var.

enabled.description: Whether bridge queries are active for this project

allowed_intents.description: If non-empty, restricts bridge to this intent set

observability.description: Observability publication endpoint and optional credential reference. The credential id resolves through the shared credential store; no resolved secret is committed here.

push_throttle_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between network pushes. Zero publishes immediately.

stage_profiles.description: Named per-stage prompt-composition profiles keyed by stage then by slug. The verifier/reviewer stages supersede verifier_profiles/reviewer_profiles; execution_profile.topology.verifier_sequence supersedes app_type_verifier_map. Each profile's prompt_files compose base-first.

precondition_policies.description: Top-level named registry of verifier precondition policies (verifier-precondition-policy plan, Slice B). Each entry is a named policy: an ordered list of predicates over the unified event/signal contract that all must hold for the in_progress -> awaiting_agent_review gate to open. A stage profile references a policy by name via precondition_policy; the verifier reads the resolved policy from the lockfile. Absent => the built-in 'default' gate applies.

locks.description: Section 15 D1a authority-axis lock block emitted by a layer in the policy-authority pass (Phase 1). value_locks pin a field (rejecting lower-scope writes); deny_locks subtract a set member (deny-overrides). force_allow is invalid and aborts the resolve (the no-force-allow invariant). A lock binds only scopes ranked below its owner on the AUTHORITY-RANK total order (org > team > repo > user).

value_locks.description: Field path -> pinned value. A lower-authority scope that writes a different value has its write rejected; da config explain surfaces attempted/winning/owner.

deny_locks.description: Set-member denials, each 'field:member' (e.g. 'skills:risky-skill'). deny-overrides: a lower-scope union-add of the member is dropped.

force_allow.description: ALWAYS invalid: any entry is a resolve-time validation error. A lower scope can never punch a capability through a higher deny.

authority_grants.description: Section 15 D1a source-authority registry: a per-source allowlist 'source-id -> scope it may carry'. Honored only when written by a layer whose own authority is at least the conferred scope; a lower scope cannot self-bless authority (a resolve-time rejection). A value-only source's claim is inert unless co-signed by a trusted root.

layering_policy.description: Unified-config-profiles (L1) scope-attached layering policy: the Phase-1 governance a scope emits for the profile selector-merge engine. Its owning authority scope is SOURCE-derived (from the layer it lives in), never authored here. precedence orders scopes low->high for value resolution; locks are absolute deny/value pins (NO force-allow, Decision 4); override_permissions is the Decision-2 three-state cap (omitted=no opinion, {}=lockdown, non-empty=allowlist); mode is the Q4 replace-mode marker.

precedence.description: Scope ordering low->high for value resolution (later wins scalar conflicts). Empty falls back to the canonical AUTHORITY-RANK order.

mode.description: Decision-3 / Q4 merge mode. 'narrow' (default) may only tighten lower grants; 'replace' supersedes the inherited precedence + override_permissions as a visible, named act. Locks always accumulate regardless.

override_permissions.description: Decision-2 three-state cap, keyed by authority scope -> permitted field-paths ('*' = all). OMITTED (field absent) = no opinion / inherit-higher; explicit {} = lockdown (no scope may change anything); explicit non-empty = allowlist (a scope absent from the map may change nothing).

locks.description: Absolute layering locks (Decision 4): deny-lock (force members out of a set field, forbidding lower-scope re-grant) or value-lock (pin a scalar). There is NO force-allow lock; a force_allow key is a validation error.

deny.description: Set members forced out of field and forbidden from lower-scope re-grant. Mutually exclusive with value.

value.description: Scalar pinned for field (value-lock). Mutually exclusive with deny.

selector.description: Optional context scoping for the lock (empty = all contexts). Exact-match selector keys only.

manifests.description: Distributable-config-manifest (L2) scope-attached manifest units, keyed by name; each manifest's absolute ref is <owning-source>:<name>. A manifest is the ONE publishable bundle that REFERENCES (by ref) the canonical sources to pull, the layering policy/profiles that bind, and (optionally) the project-set to manage — the inputs `init --from` reproduces a setup from. It never inlines copies, carries NO secrets, and NEVER self-declares authority (source-derived, D4). A manifest->manifest edge (extends/inherits/composes), an authority/scope/authority_grants self-declaration, and force_allow are validation errors, not silently dropped.

additionalProperties.description: One kind:manifest unit. Carries only references; identity + authority are loader-stamped, never authored.

sources.description: Canonical source refs to pull, fully PINNED as <source>:<path>@<version>. Names only — a private source carries no credential; auth is threaded ambient-first at init --from, never embedded. An unpinned/mutable source ref is rejected: hashing it as a stable input would be false reproducibility.

binds.description: Refs of the layering_policy + profile units that bind. Empty = bind whatever the scope chain resolves; non-empty narrows the bound fragments to exactly these refs.

project_set.description: OPTIONAL ref of a kind:project-set unit (the portable identity registry). Absent = a manifest with no project-set, which is valid and resolves.

verifier_profiles.description: DEPRECATED: folded into stage_profiles.verifier on load and never re-emitted. Use stage_profiles.verifier.

reviewer_profiles.description: DEPRECATED: folded into stage_profiles.reviewer on load and never re-emitted. Use stage_profiles.reviewer.

app_type_verifier_map.description: DEPRECATED: folded into execution_profile.by_app_type.<type>.topology.verifier_sequence on load and never re-emitted. Use execution_profile.

refresh.description: DEPRECATED: refresh metadata (version/commit/describe/refreshedAt for the last da install/refresh) now lives in .agentsrc.lock's "refresh" section (see internal/config.RefreshMetadata / WriteRefreshLock), not the committed manifest. This property is unconstrained — any legacy shape (including a full 40-char commit SHA) still validates — because it is ignored on load and stripped on the next `da refresh`/manifest rewrite; never re-emitted.

repo_id.description: v2: canonical repository identity (e.g. 'github.com/acme/manager-ui'). Protected: imported layers cannot override it.

extends.description: v2: ordered list of config layer references. Each entry is either a string 'source-id:layer-path[@version]' or an object with optional flag.

packages.description: v2: ordered list of executable package references 'source-id:artifact-path@version-spec'.

features.description: v2: feature-flag overrides keyed by feature name.

execution_profile.description: config-v2 §15 execution-profile layer (kind=layer). Routes a task's workflow execution shape — unit relevance + topology + lenses — by app_type. Scope-mergeable; unlisted units default to 'situational' (default_class) so nothing is silently dropped. See skill-relevance-filter design.

by_app_type.description: Per-app_type execution shape, keyed by app_type string (e.g. 'go-cli', 'ideation').

default_class.description: Relevance class for any unit not explicitly listed. Defaults to 'situational' — unlisted units are never silently dropped.

pr_source.description: pr-event-source D4: config-driven pull-request event producer. Configures the generic internal/events producer engine (fetch + field map per platform) so PR state becomes event.pr.* events with no per-platform Go. 'gh' is the zero-config default; resolves through the config-v2 scope layers so an org layer can set the default. additionalProperties open for forward-compatible producer options.

producer.description: Named producer: 'gh' (default), 'exec', 'http', or a registered code producer.

work_tracking.description: Coordination-state storage plane (work-tracking-storage-abstraction spec). backend selects the storage plane ('local' default, 'git-ref' serves reads from refs/agents/state and implies the write mirror). read_from is the §9 read-from-master shim: 'master' resolves TASKS.yaml/PLAN.yaml from the canonical ref (origin/<default-branch>) via git show; 'worktree' (default) reads the per-worktree working copy. write_to selects the write mirror. Under backend=git-ref, coordination reads come from the local state ref (read-your-writes safe) and take precedence over read_from=master.

read_from.description: Where coordination state is READ from: 'worktree' (default) — the per-worktree working copy (today's behaviour); 'master' — the canonical ref (origin/<default-branch>) via git show. Read-side only; writes land in the working copy regardless.

write_to.description: Where a status transition is WRITTEN: 'worktree' (default) — only the per-worktree working copy (today's behaviour, no git ref written); 'state-ref' — ALSO mirror the transition to refs/agents/state via atomic compare-and-swap (git update-ref <new> <old>, retry-on-mismatch), the git-ref shared SOT orthogonal to the code branch and never merged into the default branch. Additive: the working copy is written regardless. Backend selection (work_tracking.backend) supersedes this focused gate in a later task.

backend.description: Coordination-state STORAGE PLANE (D7/D8/D9 scope ladder). 'local' (default) — the per-worktree working copy (today's behaviour). 'git-ref' — reads project TASKS.yaml/PLAN.yaml from the shared state ref (refs/agents/state) per-task blobs (read-your-writes safe, a local ref) and IMPLY the state-ref write mirror even when write_to is unset; git-ref takes precedence over read_from=master for coordination reads. Reserved (validate but treated as local until implemented): 'kg', 'cloudflare-do', 'jira', 'linear'.

promptFileRef.description: A verifier/reviewer prompt_files entry. Source-aware (config-v2 Q1, Option B): the typed-object form {source,path,version} pins a prompt to a config source; the bare-string legacy form is equivalent to {path:<string>} resolved on the local prompt search path.

source.description: Config source id the prompt is fetched from (matches a sources[].id). Empty/absent means local resolution.

path.description: Prompt file path, relative to the source (or the local prompt search path when source is absent).

version.description: Source-relative revision to pin. Absent means 'as resolved'.

stageProfileMap.description: A map of profile slug -> stage profile (label + explicit OMP model route + base-first prompt_files composition).

model.description: Concrete OMP model identifier for this stage. This does not select or imply a vendor-specific CLI harness.

model_family.description: Open-ended semantic model family used to enforce cross-family reviewer diversity (for example claude, gpt, gemini). Diversity checks compare family identity; this is intentionally not a closed enum.

precondition_policy.description: Name of a verifier precondition policy in the top-level precondition_policies registry that gates this profile's in_progress -> awaiting_agent_review transition. Unset => built-in 'default' gate (verifier-precondition-policy plan, Slice B).

preconditionPolicy.description: One named verifier precondition policy: an ordered list of predicates all of which must hold for the gate to open.

predicates.description: Ordered predicates over the unified event/signal contract. All must hold; the first failing predicate's reason is surfaced.

predicateSpec.description: A predicate over one registered event/signal kind.

type.description: v2: http and oci added per config-distribution-model §4. v1 files declaring only local/git remain valid.

id.description: v2: stable local identifier used in extends/packages refs.

scope.description: v2 (config-transitive-layering / config-distribution-model D16): distributed-scope discriminator. ROUTING/ownership metadata only — seeds scoped-content routing (D13) and explain/editability UI. NOT an authority grant: an imported layer stays public authority until an authority_grants blessing upgrades it (D1a). Absent on v1 sources (byte-stable).

owner.description: v2 (config-distribution-model D16): who owns this source (e.g. 'acme-platform', 'acme-team', 'payout'). Ownership metadata for explain/routing UI. Optional even for scoped sources; absent on public/v1 sources.

cache_ttl.description: v2: tier-1 cache TTL duration (e.g. '4h'). Ignored for oci sources.

auth.description: v2: opaque auth block. Schema owned by external-agent-sources spec; treated as pass-through here. Well-known pass-through keys read by the config layer: 'signing' (unsigned|optional|required — package signing-posture stub, config-distribution-model §12) and 'token' (bearer token for http package pulls).

signing.description: v2 (p5 stub): package signing posture. 'required' fails resolution for an unverifiable artifact once cosign/sigstore verification lands; defaults to 'unsigned'.

cache_keys.description: v2: per-source content cache-key override (config-distribution-model §7A.4, the uv 'cache-keys' analog). Absent ⇒ the source uses its kind default (git→resolved commit; local→commit + working-tree; http→ETag/Last-Modified else digest; oci→manifest digest). Any selector below pins the key on those inputs instead; always_revalidate is the config-declared force escape.

file.description: File paths or globs whose tracked content pins the key — a change to any matched file is a new key.

git.description: Selects which git facts pin the key.

commit.description: Pin the key on the resolved commit hash.

tags.description: Pin the key on the tags pointing at the resolved commit (a re-tag is a new key).

env.description: Environment variable names whose values pin the key.

dir.description: Directory paths whose presence/absence pins the key.

always_revalidate.description: Config-declared force escape: always re-check upstream on resolve, regardless of the recorded digest (config-distribution-model §7A.4 / R6).

layerRef.description: v2: extends entry. Either a plain reference string 'source-id:layer-path[@version]' or an object with optional flag.

packageRef.description: v2: packages entry. Reference string 'source-id:artifact-path@version-spec' or object form.

prFetchBlock.description: pr-event-source D4: one named fetch block of a pr_source config. exec sets 'argv'; http sets 'url'/'method'/'headers'. 'each' selects the item list and 'map' projects each item onto canonical PR fields (canonical-field -> jsonpath).

argv.description: exec: command and arguments. '{number}' is substituted per PR in the comments block.

each.description: JSONPath to the list of items in the fetched document (e.g. '.' for the top-level array, '.comments').

map.description: Canonical field -> JSONPath (relative to an item). The reserved 'rollup' field should point at the platform's raw check array (gh: '.statusCheckRollup'); the producer derives the canonical Rollup.State (GREEN|FAILING|PENDING) from it on each cycle.

appTypeProfile.description: The execution facets for one app_type: unit relevance, topology, lenses, and the graph_backend adapter-ref. Each facet is independently scope-overridable.

relevance.description: Facet 1 (the noise filter): per-stage core/situational/noise unit classification, keyed by stage name (e.g. 'orchestrate', 'verify', 'review').

graph_backend.description: Facet 4: the graph-backend adapter-ref this app_type selects (app-type-profiles §2.6/§3.1). An open adapter-ref of the form 'dotagents-builtin:graph/<name>@<constraint>' (or a bare '<name>'), resolved against the graph-backend adapter registry (graph-backend-adapter-contract §4/§8) — not a closed enum. Omit to inherit the pipeline default backend (crg).

relevanceClasses.description: Partitions the units relevant to one app_type × stage into reversible-view classes. Unlisted units default to default_class.

topology.description: Facet 2: the executor:verifier:reviewer fan-out shape. Supersedes the flat app_type_verifier_map (verifier_sequence moves here).

executors.description: Number of parallel executor workers for the task.

verifiers_per_executor.description: Verifier fan-out per executor (n exec → verifiers_per_executor·n verifiers).

reviewers.description: Reviewer fan-out: a keyword ('per_verifier', 'per_executor') or a stringified integer count.

verifier_sequence.description: Ordered verifier-profile ids for this app_type, superseding app_type_verifier_map.

lenses.description: Facet 3: the review-lens config folded in from lens-evidence-policy.
